# Northbridge Casino — Welcome Bonus Terms

These terms apply to the Northbridge welcome offer and form part of the General Terms and Conditions.

1. The Offer

1.1 New players receive a 100% match bonus on their first deposit up to €200.
1.2 The minimum qualifying deposit is €20.

2. Wagering

2.1 The bonus amount must be wagered 35 times before it can be converted into withdrawable cash.
2.2 You have 7 days from the moment the bonus is credited to complete the wagering requirement.
2.3 Slots contribute 100% to the wagering requirement. Live casino games contribute 10%. Table games contribute 5%.
2.4 A list of 42 excluded games is published on the promotions page. Bets on excluded games do not count and may void the bonus.

3. Bonus Rules

3.1 While a bonus is active the maximum bet is €5 per spin or round. Any bet above this amount will void the bonus and any winnings.
3.2 Your real money balance is always used before your bonus balance.
3.3 The maximum amount you can withdraw from bonus winnings is €1,000. Any amount above this will be removed from your balance.
3.4 If you request a withdrawal before the wagering requirement is complete, the bonus and all winnings from it will be forfeited.
3.5 Northbridge may cancel any bonus where it considers the offer has been abused.
